[P2] Retry temporarily invisible execution reads during cleanup

An accepted Invoke can return an ARN before execution reads become available, as `finish()` already handles. Here, a known ARN receives one read; `ResourceNotFoundException` becomes an immediate cleanup failure. If a case fails shortly after Invoke, settlement can therefore abort without stopping its execution and quarantine the fixture despite available drain time. Retry this read within a bounded cleanup deadline without repeating Invoke. Add a known-ARN regression where the first read is unavailable and the next returns `RUNNING`, verifying that cleanup stops it.
